A CONCEPT FOR WHATSAPP
Goodbye, inbox chaos. Hello, WhatsApp.
Your email, where your people already are.
Concept by Rahul Vedula · Not an official WhatsApp product
Sources: Harvard Business Review, 2022 (via Axios) · Qatalog × Cornell University Idea Lab (via Atlassian)
THE PROBLEM
One simple job. Two apps. Lots of tapping.
Chat here, email there
You agree in WhatsApp. Then you open another app to send the file.
Where did it go?
The answer is in a chat… or an email. So you search twice.
Is this email real?
Fake senders hide in crowded inboxes. It is hard to tell who is who.
~1,200
9.5 min
to get back on track after switching apps
times a day the average worker switches between apps and websites
THE IDEA
Email, living right next to your chats.
STEP 1
Get your own @whatsapp.com address
STEP 2
Turn any chat into an email in one tap
STEP 3
Chats and emails in one list, one search
THE BUSINESS CASE
A big win for people, and for business.
3B+
people already use WhatsApp every month. Email gives them one more reason to stay.
200M+
people use WhatsApp Business every month. Chat to email, without leaving.
9.5 min
to refocus after each app switch. One app means fewer switches.
More reasons to open WhatsApp every day
A stronger toolkit for WhatsApp Business
Verified @whatsapp.com senders, less spam
Sources: Meta, Q1 2025 earnings call (3B+) · Meta via TechCrunch, Jun 2023 (200M+) · Qatalog × Cornell Idea Lab (9.5 min)
THE ASK
Let’s build it together.
Three small steps to start.
1
Pilot
Start with WhatsApp Business: turn a chat into an email in one tap.
2
Learn
See if people keep coming back, and whether they trust verified senders.
3
Grow
Open @whatsapp.com addresses to everyone who chats here.

APPENDIX · USER STORY
Story 1: B2B bulk order
As an oil trader, I want to turn a rate agreed in chat into a formal quotation, purchase order and invoice, so deals close faster and my buyer’s accountant gets proper paperwork.
1
Rate agreed in chat. WhatsApp offers to continue in email.
2
Quotation drafted from the chat, with GST and terms.
3
One order thread: chat, quotation, PO and invoice.
Fictional names and numbers
APPENDIX · USER STORY
Story 2: Travel booking
As a traveller, I want to book a trip in chat and get my tickets in the same place, so I never dig through my inbox, even on the day of travel.
1
Book in chat. Tickets arrive as a card in the same chat.
2
Itinerary, e-tickets and hotel voucher in one email.
3
On the day: delay and cab alerts from the Email Assistant.
Fictional names and numbers
APPENDIX · USER STORY
Story 3: E-commerce support
As a customer with a damaged order, I want to complain in chat and get a ticket I can track, so I never have to explain the problem twice.
1
Complaint and photos sent in chat.
2
Agent turns the chat into a ticket email. Photos and invoice are added automatically.
3
Customer sees ticket status: received, under review, refund.
Fictional names and numbers
